description: Public safety verdict for ONE package (optionally one version) from CyberXYZ's global threat data: known-malicious releases (always shown in full), advisories, commit-level analysis and version anomalies. Call it BEFORE adding or installing an npm, PyPI, Go or NuGet dependency. `decision`: block or quarantine = do not install; alert = installable but flagged; allow = ok; unknown = no record, not vetted: ask the user; unverified = the check did not complete: retry, then ask the user. Signing in adds the full install-time verdict (see `sign_in_adds`).
